events.title: Emperor Huizong abdicates in favour of his son Qinzong
events.description: With Jin troops across the Yellow River and in sight of the capital, Bianjing, Emperor Huizong of Song abdicated in favour of his eldest son, Zhao Huan. As Emperor Qinzong he was the last ruler of the Northern Song.
events.html: With Jin troops across the Yellow River and in sight of the capital, Bianjing, Emperor Huizong of Song abdicated in favour of his eldest son, Zhao Huan. As Emperor Qinzong he was the last ruler of the Northern Song.

events.title: Francisco Pizarro founds Lima
events.description: Pizarro founded the 'City of Kings' on the Rímac river near the Pacific coast. Lima became the capital of the Viceroyalty of Peru, created in 1542, and the centre of Spanish rule in South America.
events.html: Pizarro founded the 'City of Kings' on the Rímac river near the Pacific coast. Lima became the capital of the Viceroyalty of Peru, created in 1542, and the centre of Spanish rule in South America.

events.title: Pereiaslav Council places the Cossack Hetmanate under the Tsar
events.description: Hetman Bohdan Khmelnytsky and his Cossack officers swore allegiance to Tsar Alexei in return for protection against Poland-Lithuania. The agreement's meaning remains disputed in Ukrainian and Russian history.

events.title: James Cook becomes the first European to sight Hawaii
events.description: On his third voyage, Cook sighted Oahu and then Kauai, where he landed two days later. He named the archipelago the Sandwich Islands and was killed there in February 1779.
events.html: On his third voyage, Cook sighted Oahu and then Kauai, where he landed two days later. He named the archipelago the Sandwich Islands and was killed there in February 1779.

events.title: Wilhelm I proclaimed German Emperor at Versailles
events.description: In the Hall of Mirrors at Versailles, with Paris still under siege, Prussia's king was proclaimed Emperor of a united Germany. Bismarck's creation dominated continental Europe until 1918.
events.html: In the Hall of Mirrors at Versailles, with Paris still under siege, Prussia's king was proclaimed Emperor of a united Germany. Bismarck's creation dominated continental Europe until 1918.

events.title: Japan presents its Twenty-One Demands to China
events.description: Japan secretly pressed Yuan Shikai's government for extensive rights in Shandong, Manchuria and beyond. China accepted a reduced version under ultimatum, fuelling Chinese nationalism against Japan.
events.html: Japan secretly pressed Yuan Shikai's government for extensive rights in Shandong, Manchuria and beyond. China accepted a reduced version under ultimatum, fuelling Chinese nationalism against Japan.

events.title: Soviet forces open a land corridor into besieged Leningrad
events.description: In Operation Iskra, Soviet troops linked up south of Lake Ladoga, creating a narrow corridor into Leningrad after 16 months of siege. The blockade was finally lifted in January 1944.
events.html: In Operation Iskra, Soviet troops linked up south of Lake Ladoga, creating a narrow corridor into Leningrad after 16 months of siege. The blockade was finally lifted in January 1944.

events.title: Willie O'Ree breaks the NHL colour barrier
events.description: Playing for the Boston Bruins against the Montreal Canadiens, Willie O'Ree became the first Black player in the National Hockey League, despite being almost blind in one eye.
